component.name: D2rlmm
component.summary: Manage Diablo II: Resurrected mods on Linux

description.p: D2rlmm builds a Diablo II: Resurrected mod set from the mods you enable, in the order you choose, and writes the merged game data where the game will load it. It runs D2RMM mods unmodified — the mod API, the config schema and the install order are the same, so existing mods work as they are.

ul.li: Runs existing D2RMM mods (mod.js) unmodified in an embedded QuickJS engine
Per-mod settings generated from each mod's own mod.json
Ordering controls, because install order decides conflicts
Installs into a mod folder (for -mod NAME -txt) or straight into a data folder (for -direct -txt)
Reads vanilla data from the game's own CASC archives or from an extracted data tree
Writes a shareable error report with the log, mod list and settings

description.p: Launching the game is deliberately left to Steam, Lutris or whatever else already does it well; D2rlmm shows you the launch options to use instead.

ul.li: D2RMM-compatible mod engine (mod.js, config schema, install order)
Mod-folder and direct data-folder install targets
CASC and extracted-data sources for vanilla files
Error reports with logs and environment
